svg.title: Three rules, one policy
svg.desc: Implementation policy separates saved-view pin admission from global currency, verifies original evidence and delivery currency, and never promotes a proposed relationship just because its owner is implemented. Current source links ground the extension points only.

g.text: TECHNICAL INVENTORY · PROPOSED DESIGN / 10
Three rules, one policy
Decisions for implementation; public authoring and storage are not changed yet.
HISTORICAL LINK
r1 saved · r2 globally current
A new link explicitly requests r1.
ADMIT ONLY THROUGH AN EXACT, VALID SAVED VIEW
Readable history is not global currency.
Keep global health visible. Admission grants no coverage.
IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE
Original C0 · delivery C1
A valid old code pin is not enough.
VERIFY ORIGINAL BYTES, THEN RESOLVE AT DELIVERY
Moved lines can pass; changed bytes refuse.
Name C1 once. Preserve original pins. Failure publishes nothing.
MIXED INTENT
Entity built; edge proposed
The relationship is still work to do.
PROMOTION NEVER CASCADES
Check each implemented edge independently.
Implemented endpoints + edge evidence; proposed edges remain.
Existing foundations: current-only pin guard and original/view code resolvers.
Detailed contract: docs/technical-inventory-policy-contract.md · no automatic approval or coverage.
